csc.help.title: Clientside Chat — Commands Overview
csc.help.host: /csc host [password] [max_players] [hours] — Host a server & generate Session Token
csc.help.join: /csc join <token|ip|bookmark> [password] — Join via Session Token, IP or Bookmark
csc.help.msg: #/msg <player> <text> (or /csc msg) — Send a direct private whisper to a player
csc.help.list: /csc list — Show active players in your session
csc.help.sound: /csc sound [bell|ping|orb|click|anvil|off] — Change or toggle notification sound
csc.help.kick: /csc kick <player> [reason] — Kick a player from your host session
csc.help.ban: /csc ban <player> [reason] — Ban a player from your host session
csc.help.token: /csc token — Show your active Session Token
csc.help.status: /csc status — Show hosting, ECDH & log status
csc.help.message: #message — Send an ECDH AES-256-GCM encrypted message
csc.chat.connected: ✔ Connected successfully (ECDH + AES-256-GCM E2EE)! Type #message to chat.
csc.chat.not_connected: Not connected and not hosting! Use /csc host or /csc join <token>
csc.chat.host_started: ✔ Server started! (ECDH + AES-256-GCM E2EE, Max. %d players, %dh valid)
csc.chat.token_sub: (Click button below to copy. Key Pinned & E2EE!)
csc.chat.kicked_success: ✔ Player '%s' was kicked from the session.
csc.chat.kicked_fail: ✘ Player '%s' not found in your session.
csc.chat.banned_success: ✔ Player '%s' was banned from the session.
csc.chat.unbanned_fail: ✘ IP '%s' was not in the banlist.
csc.chat.connecting: Connecting via ECDH with Key Pinning...
csc.chat.no_active_token: No active Session Token. Start with /csc host
csc.chat.mitm_alert: SECURITY ALERT: Server Public Key mismatch! (MitM Attack Prevented)
csc.chat.token_verified: Token verified & Host Key Pinned! Connecting...
